content.title: What's better for your wallet: Renting or buying a home?
content.description:
As younger Americans navigate rising costs of living in this pressured economic environment, many are pondering whether it's still worth it to rent an apartment or house. While mortgage rates inch lower, 59% of American renters plan to continue renting rather than buy a house, according to a Zillow report.

Zillow Group Home Trends Expert Amanda Pendleton weighs the factors that make it more beneficial to buy rather than continue to rent, including regional differences and home value appreciation.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination Overtime.

content.title: ZG Q3 Deep Dive: AI Investments and Rentals Expansion Drive Outperformance
content.summary: Online real estate marketplace Zillow (NASDAQ:ZG) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 16.4% year on year to $676 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $650 million at the midpoint, 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.44 per share was 3.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
